record.short: NetFlow Monitoring price per million records per month rises from $0.15 to $0.65.
record.headline: Datadog raised the listed NetFlow Monitoring price from $0.15 to $0.65 per million records per month, undoing the cut seen a few days earlier.
rows: NetFlow Monitoring, per million records per month
record.who: NetFlow Monitoring customers on the retention tier shown beside this price.
record.read: The price has flipped back to its earlier level, so the previous cut may have been a page error or a short test. Treat the direction as unsettled until it holds.
record.caveat: The page lists several retention tiers (15 to 90 days and over 90 days) beside one price, so it is not certain which tier the figure applies to.

items.why: LLC plans renamed back to Pro and Premium at unchanged $249 and $299; attorney consultations return to the $249 plan, while the $299 plan loses tax filing and the full team and renews at $49 instead of $99.

record.short: Upfront prices stay at $249 and $299, but attorney consults move back to the $249 plan and the $299 plan’s renewal drops from $99 to $49.
record.plan: Managed Service → Pro, Expert Service → Premium
record.headline: LegalZoom renamed its LLC formation plans back to Pro and Premium and reshuffled them: attorney consultations are on the $249 plan again, and the $299 plan swaps the full team and tax filing for bookkeeping tools.
rows: Top plan, 30-day service renewal per month
Annual tax filings prepped and filed for you
record.who: New LLC formation buyers on the $249 and $299 plans.
record.read: This mostly reverses the late October reshuffle. Buyers of the $299 plan get less hands-on service but a lower renewal, while the $249 plan gains attorney access.
record.caveat: Upfront prices are unchanged; the change is in what each plan includes and what it renews at.
